create_feature_from_json: create a FeatureConnector from a JSON config string or dictionary
save_feature_config: save a FeatureConnector to a features.json file in a given directory
encode_example_data: encode raw example data into tf-example compatible format for writing
decode_example_data: decode tf-example data back into user-friendly tensor format
get_feature_tensor_info: get the shape and dtype tensor info for a FeatureConnector
